P1b.phase: P1b — Terrain smoothing and lag-spike elimination
P1b.ordering_notes:
Two measurement WPs go first so every later change has before/after evidence. P1b-01 is terrain metrics and the worldgen-report additions: capture build/wg-before on the parent commit. P1b-05 is F3 spike logging and perf.cmds: capture a rendering-run `perf spikes` baseline. Both are independent and can run in parallel.

Terrain chain, strictly sequential because the files are shared: P1b-01 → P1b-02 → P1b-03 → P1b-04.
- P1b-02 and P1b-03 both edit TerrainField.cs, BiomeRelief.cs, WorldPlan.cs, GenVersion.cs and WorldGenTests.cs.
- GenVersion bumps once to 10 in P1b-02. P1b-03 re-pins the golden hashes under the same version unless P1b-02 was already pushed and played, in which case it bumps to 11.
- P1b-04 changes only meshing (SurfaceNetsMesher and the new HeightfieldSmoothing) and needs no GenVersion bump. It is measured on the final terrain.

Lag-spike chain: P1b-05 → P1b-06 → P1b-07 → P1b-08 → P1b-09 → P1b-10 → P1b-11 → P1b-12; then P1b-13 → P1b-14 → P1b-15; P1b-16 only needs P1b-05.
Shared-file hotspots that force this order:
- ChunkStreamer.cs and ChunkStreamer.Scheduling.cs: P1b-05 (timer scope), P1b-07, P1b-08.
- WorldRuntime.cs: P1b-08, P1b-09, P1b-10, P1b-12.
- ChunkMesher.cs: P1b-09 (collision hashes), P1b-11 (grass hashes), P1b-12 (pooled MeshVolume).
- CaveGenerationPass.cs: P1b-03 then P1b-12.
- TileObjectRenderer.cs: P1b-05, P1b-10, P1b-13.
- NpcRenderer.cs: P1b-05, P1b-13, P1b-14.
- ProjectileRenderer.cs: P1b-05, P1b-13, P1b-15.
- WorldLauncher.cs: P1b-05, P1b-12, P1b-13, P1b-14.
- GodotCommandHost.cs (new probes): P1b-09, P1b-10, P1b-11, P1b-13, P1b-15, P1b-16. Trivial merges.
- game/Testing/Scripts/perf.cmds is created in P1b-05 and gains asserts in P1b-07/08/09/10/11/13/15.
- GameWorld.cs is 387 lines: P1b-07 must first move the save code into GameWorld.Saving.cs before anything else adds to it (P1b-09 adds only the LightDirty wiring).

Overlaps with other phases:
- data/config/graphics.json and src/Strata.Core/Presentation/GraphicsConfig.cs are edited by P1a (desert auto-exposure and glow) and by P1b-11 and P1b-15.
- game/Rendering/DynamicLights.cs is edited by P1a (torch light energy and range) and by P1b-12 (allocation-free Assign).
- game/UI/PerfOverlay.cs (P1b-05) may be restyled by the UI phase.
Land P1a's graphics and DynamicLights edits first, or rebase carefully.

Audit line references for BiomeRelief.cs, GlobalDensityPass.cs and CaveGenerationPass.cs are stale (those files are shorter), but every claim was confirmed in the current code. Findings the audit did not list, now covered here:
- MeshVolume allocates about 786 KB of large-object-heap arrays per mesh job (P1b-12).
- ExploredMap Deflate runs on the main thread in every autosave (P1b-07).
- Unload-only saves never rewrite world.json id tables, which risks unresolvable ids after a crash (P1b-06).
- The ruggedness grid is never blurred (P1b-02).

Every WP must end with: dotnet build and Core tests; Strata.Tools validate, manifest --check and coverage; gen_reference --check; build_all.py --check; check_file_length.py; all game/Testing/Scripts/*.cmds printing SMOKE PASS headless; the menu tour. Terrain WPs also attach worldgen-report --compare output and lavapipe tour shots. Perf WPs also attach before/after `perf spikes` from a rendering run of perf.cmds.

- game/Player/PlayerAvatar.Motion.cs: P1-06 (facing), then P1-11 (play on UseSerial).
- game/Entities/SwingTrail.cs: P1-06, then P1-11.
- game/Player/ViewModel.cs: P1-11, then P1-14 (ranged poses in a new partial).
- game/Ambience/EnvironmentController.cs: P1-03, then P1-04 (one GlobalShaderParameterSet line).
- game/Debug/GodotCommandHost.cs: small additive probe edits in P1-03, P1-05, P1-06, P1-07 and P1-08 (P1-08 removes player.hook here and moves it to StandardProbes).

Conventions this plan keeps:
- Core never references Godot. New Core logic: LightingConfig, ExposureModel, TargetFilter/CastView/CastWhere, EntityPicking, GrappleHook, UseTiming, ShotGeometry, all with Core tests.

Performance:
- Entity picking and targeting are allocation-free per tick.
- DynamicLights.Assign drops LINQ, and GrappleVisual drops its per-quad allocation.
- Exposure is written only when it changes.
- The nocked-arrow mesh is preloaded on item select.
- Low gets only 4 shadowless omni lights.

Already fixed by later packages (no separate work needed):
- The audit's 'Reach stat ignored by cursor' (P1-05/06).
- 'Talk targeting capped by the behind-hit' (P1-06 interim, P1-07 final).
- 'Zenith Blocked' (P1-16).

Deliberately left for later phases:
- Swing hitbox plane (horizontal hitbox vs overhead clip).
- Per-item grip/muzzle sockets, muzzle flash, gun bursts.

P4.phase: P4 — Bosses and a 1:1 Skeletron Dungeon (audit section I). All paths are relative to /home/user/3D-Terraria.
P4.ordering_notes:
All paths are relative to /home/user/3D-Terraria.

**Recommended order**

The order follows what an early-game player meets.
1. Framework first: P4-01, then P4-02 and P4-03, then P4-04. P4-12 and P4-13 have no dependencies and can run in parallel with these.
2. Early-game bosses: P4-05 (natural arrivals), P4-06 (King Slime and Eye), P4-07 (Eater), P4-08 (Brain), P4-09 (Queen Bee and Deerclops).
3. Skeletron at the dungeon door: P4-10, then P4-11. In Terraria you must beat Skeletron before you can enter the dungeon.
4. The dungeon interior: P4-14 → P4-15 → P4-16. Then P4-17 → P4-18 → P4-19, then P4-20 → P4-21, then P4-22 and P4-23.
5. Wall of Flesh (P4-24), then hardmode: P4-25 bags, P4-26 Queen Slime, P4-27 Destroyer and Twins, P4-28 Prime, P4-29 models, then P4-30 Plantera and P4-31 Golem, P4-32 Duke and Empress, P4-33 → P4-34 biome weapons and chests.

- Terraria numbers are the 1.4 Classic values from memory; items marked "tune" should be checked against the reference before release. The one deliberate deviation is the Destroyer. It keeps Terraria's shared 80,000 life with per-segment defense and one probe per plate, instead of the audit's per-segment life. A data switch (BossInfo.SegmentLife) exists if the player prefers segments that break off.
